title: Otran
desc: A group of terrorists kidnaps Sudha and takes over her apartment to save their employer Robert. Karthik, a RAW agent, pretends to be a cook and goes to her house to capture the entire gang.

title: Mazhai
desc: Two men, a jobless guy and a powerful don, fall for the same girl on a rainy day at a railway station, sparking a tense rivalry.

title: Thotti Jaya
desc: An orphan named Thotti Jaya is hired by a mobster after he is spotted thrashing a dishonest man. However, his troubles begin when he falls in love with his boss' daughter.

title: 49-O
desc: When the farmers of a village are tricked into selling their lands to a local politician, a man sympathetic to the plight of farmers decides to get them their properties back.

title: Ullathai Allitha
desc: Tired of his father's disciplinarian ways and to avoid marrying a girl chosen by the latter, Raja runs away to Ooty. There, he is hired as a driver by the man whose daughter he was supposed to marry.
